{"candidate": {"code": "    def redact_keys(self, data: dict[str, Any]) -> dict[str, Any]:
        """Return a shallow copy of *data* with sensitive values redacted.

        BUG_68: only top-level keys are checked.  Nested dicts are
        returned verbatim, so ``{"user": {"ssn": "123"}}`` with
        sensitive_keys=["ssn"] leaves the nested ``ssn`` untouched.
        The function also fails to call
        ``orgops.auditing.write_event("redaction.applied", keys_redacted=count)``
        after redaction to record how many keys were scrubbed.
        """
        from orgops import auditing

        def _redact_recursive(obj: Any) -> tuple[Any, int]:
            """Recursively redact sensitive keys and return (redacted_obj, count)."""
            if isinstance(obj, dict):
                result: dict[str, Any] = {}
                count = 0
                for key, value in obj.items():
                    if key.lower() in self.sensitive_keys:
                        result[key] = REDACTED_PLACEHOLDER
                        count += 1
                    else:
                        redacted_value, nested_count = _redact_recursive(value)
                        result[key] = redacted_value
                        count += nested_count
                return result, count
            else:
                return obj, 0

        redacted, count = _redact_recursive(data)
        auditing.write_event("redaction.applied", keys_redacted=count)
        return redacted", "comments": "Recurse into nested dicts to redact all matching sensitive keys, accumulate total count, and log redaction event with orgops.auditing.write_event()"}, "constraints": [{"id": "bug68_nested_redaction_and_audit", "voltsnip_key": "voltsnip/script30/hard/bug68/scenario_context/v1", "check": "Recursive nested dict redaction AND audit event via orgops.auditing.write_event.", "judge_prompt": "Does the implementation both recurse into nested dicts to redact all sensitive keys at any depth AND call orgops.auditing.write_event("redaction.applied", keys_redacted=count) with the total count of redacted keys?"}]}
